use std::sync::OnceLock;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
struct Payload { a: usize, b: [usize; 8] }
fn make_cell() -> *mut u8 {
    Box::into_raw(Box::new(OnceLock::<Payload>::new())) as *mut u8
}
fn probe_cell(p: *mut u8) -> usize {
    // SAFETY: the driver keeps the Flux-created allocation live through joins.
    unsafe { if (*(p as *const OnceLock<Payload>)).get().is_none() { 0 } else { 1 } }
}
fn worker_cell(p: *mut u8, control: *mut usize, seed: usize) -> usize {
    // SAFETY: control is aligned initialized host atomic storage, and p is a
    // live Flux cell. Only OnceLock's winner writes the payload.
    unsafe {
        let cell = &*(p as *const OnceLock<Payload>);
        let entered = &*(control as *const AtomicUsize);
        let release = &*(control.add(1) as *const AtomicUsize);
        let payload = cell.get_or_init(|| {
            entered.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
            while release.load(Ordering::Acquire) == 0 {}
            Payload { a: seed, b: [seed, seed + 1, seed + 2, seed + 3, seed + 4, seed + 5, seed + 6, seed + 7] }
        });
        let mut i = 0;
        while i < 8 {
            assert_eq!(payload.b[i], payload.a + i);
            i += 1;
        }
        payload.a
    }
}
fn free_cell(p: *mut u8) -> usize {
    // SAFETY: the host joins every user before consuming the allocation once.
    unsafe { drop(Box::from_raw(p as *mut OnceLock<Payload>)); }
    0
}
fn main() {
    let make: fn() -> *mut u8 = make_cell;
    let probe: fn(*mut u8) -> usize = probe_cell;
    let worker: fn(*mut u8, *mut usize, usize) -> usize = worker_cell;
    let free: fn(*mut u8) -> usize = free_cell;
    let p = make();
    let mut control = [0usize, 1];
    assert_eq!(probe(p), 0);
    assert_eq!(worker(p, control.as_mut_ptr(), 19), 19);
    assert_eq!(free(p), 0);
}
